svg.title: Control Perspective: Closed-Loop Routing
svg.desc: An editorial figure showing a closed feedback loop and a contracting trust region, with deterministic labels for measurement, trust-region control, bounded metric update, and Lyapunov-inspired stability indicators.
svg.text: Closed-loop routing with instantaneous, judge-free feedback.

g.text: Operational indicators, not a formal proof.

svg.text: Adequacy should be measured, not asserted.
